## Why This Is Asked

It assesses whether candidates can balance privacy requirements—such as differential privacy and regulatory compliance—with production concerns including latency, drift detection, and safe model rollout.

- **Federated fine-tuning**: cross-tenant gradient aggregation without raw data exposure, differential privacy guarantees during model updates
- **Domain adaptation**: weak supervision signals, label propagation across tenant domains, adapter fine-tuning strategies
- **Governance workflow**: staged rollout, rollback mechanisms, drift detection thresholds, audit trails
